utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s picking up again. I can swing by after errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that helps. Let’s set a clear time so I know when to be ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll be there after errands, around three o’clock, and I’ll let you know if I hit any delay.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that. What do I need to know?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll bring the drive details and drop them by your place.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, just leave them with me when you drop by.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re talking about the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that’s the one. I just want to make sure I can get the schedule and drop-off details straight.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, the repair drive. Can you confirm the schedule and drop-off details are all set?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to ask Cleo about that — I can help, just remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the list somewhere, but I’m missing the exact pieces right now. Give me a minute and I’ll tell you what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No rush, just let me know when you find the list and I’ll help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to confirm, what exactly needs repairing on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it’s the driveway crack near the garage, and maybe the loose edge by the walkway. I may be forgetting one more spot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So it’s the crack by the garage and the loose edge by the walkway, and if there’s another spot, can you point it out before we start?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late - what's left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly the big stuff now. We still need a few hands for the shelf brackets and the porch screen, if you're able to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I can help with both. Point me to the shelf brackets first and I’ll take the porch screen after.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Gus. Tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Sam. The porch light’s been flickering, and my old ladder’s ready if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Gus. I’ll take a look at that porch light, and if I need the ladder I’ll be careful with it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep an eye on the repair drive list if you want; just tell me where the pickup spot is.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can leave it by the front porch after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll check the front porch after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive's picking up speed today. Folks around here are pitching in, so Quinn, you might want to swing by and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll swing by in a bit and see what still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I’d come sooner rather than later. There’s always a few odd jobs that need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's the plan for the repair drive, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can handle the sign-up list and tools if you can organize the pickups and keep track of donations. I’ll send you the details I have so far.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. Send me the pickup details, and I’ll keep track of the donations.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. Let’s keep the list moving and I’ll pass the plan along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll keep an ear out and pass along whatever I hear.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’ll keep passing it along as I hear updates.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I can organize that and keep it moving. Tell me what repairs you still need, and I’ll add them to the drive list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I still need someone to look at the bathroom sink and the front steps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll add both to the list and make sure the bathroom sink and front steps are included for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is moving along, but folks are still waiting on a few parts. Eli, I can ask around and see who needs help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can do that, Eli. I’ll ask around and see who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just the last few fixes now: a loose hinge, one window latch, and two patches of trim paint. I told folks we’d finish them today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll take the hinge so we can finish the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What do you need from the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just a few screws and a replacement hinge, if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I do, yes. I’ll bring them over now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, where should I drop the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just leave it by the front door.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help keep everyone in the loop if you want me to.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please keep me posted on the details before you tell everyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I think I missed the latest update, but I can still help if you tell me what changed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Not much changed, just a couple of new repairs added and the sign-up sheet moved to the front table. If you can come by this week, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I can swing by this week and help with the new repairs. I'll check the front table for the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive's moving along. Want me to check whether they still need hands or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, if you can check both, that’d help. We could probably use a few more hands and any spare screws or tape they’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll swing by and ask around for both. If I hear of any spare screws or tape, I’ll bring them too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What still needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly the wiring and the front hinge. I can grab the parts if you can take a look today.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take a look this afternoon. Grab the parts and I’ll meet you by the front door.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing and whether we’ve got enough people lined up. Can we make sure the drive won’t get stalled by missing supplies or no-shows?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let’s check the supply list and line up backups for any no-shows before the day of the drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds better, but can we also make a quick backup checklist so we know exactly what to do if something is missing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling everyone about the repair drive now. Come by if you can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring some tools and check what supplies are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Cleo. I’ll spread the word that you’re bringing tools and we still need supplies, so people can come prepared.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help if you tell me what time the repair crew is coming; I need to work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think it's around 3:30, but I should check and make sure. I'll let you know as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive on my list, Nell. I’ll keep things moving and let you know what still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa. Let me know what still needs a hand and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep track of what still needs a hand and pass it along.
